transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well... I'm just here because I've been feeling... restless, I guess. It's like I'm wound too tight. I just can't seem to settle down, even when I'm trying to do something quiet, like... painting, or yoga, or sitting in a planning meeting at work.
Do you often have trouble paying attention?

I suppose... sometimes. At work, mostly. Over the past couple of years, I'll think I’ve checked a vendor spreadsheet carefully... but then our planning coordinator catches something. Like I transposed a SKU, or... missed a freight surcharge. Or maybe I carried the wrong quantity into the purchase order. Just... things like that, I guess.
Have you ever had a period of several days when you felt unusually energized or on top of the world?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I don't really get like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot most days?
No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things, I guess. But... nothing out of the ordinary.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or unable to stay still?

I guess so. Um... mostly just when I'm on calls with suppliers. My foot is usually bouncing under the desk, and... I might be clicking a pen, or twisting my ring. Just doing it so much that I end up having to mute myself... or move my hands out of view. But... yeah. Just small things like that.
Did these attention and restlessness symptoms start before age 12?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I mean... back in elementary school, I'd get notes sent home sometimes. Just... for popping out of my seat, mostly. And... I guess I would talk over the other kids, or rush to answer things before the teacher even finished asking. So... yes.
Do you often interrupt people or blurt out answers before they’ve finished speaking?

I suppose so... sometimes. Um... like during vendor negotiations at work. Or... I do some STEM mentoring, too. I might... jump in with an answer before the other person is actually done talking. And then I realize I missed some important qualifier they were about to say. So... yeah. That happens.
Do you often have difficulty sustaining your attention when doing tasks that require prolonged focus?
Um... I don't really think so. I mean... I seem to do okay with my work. I haven't really noticed a problem with that.
Do you often lose things needed for tasks or activities, like your keys, phone, or paperwork?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I usually know where my things are. I don't really have a problem with losing my keys or my phone, or anything like that. So... no.
Do you often make careless mistakes when doing work or other activities?

Um... sometimes, I guess. Over the past couple of years... I'll think I checked a vendor spreadsheet pretty carefully. But then... our planning coordinator will catch something. Like... I transposed a SKU, or... missed a freight surcharge. Or maybe I carried the wrong quantity into the purchase order. So... yeah, I suppose that happens.
Do these restlessness and impulsive behaviors cause problems for you in more than one part of your life, like at work and at home?

Um... I mean, I guess so. At work... like I was saying, it just leads to corrected purchase orders, and... my planning coordinator having to do extra reviews. And at home... I don't know, family dinners can get kind of tense. They feel like I talk over them sometimes. So... yeah, I suppose.
Do you often feel physically unable to stay seated when you’re expected to remain seated?

Um... yeah, I suppose. If a meeting runs a bit long... or we're having one of those tense dinners with my in-laws... I tend to find reasons to get up. Like... getting water, or checking the oven... or going to look at samples. I just... don't really like staying in my chair for all of it.
Do you often have difficulty sustaining your attention when doing tasks that require prolonged focus?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I don't think so. I can usually get through what I need to do.
Do you often have trouble staying focused when you’re doing a task, even when it’s something important to you?
Um... no. Like I just said, I don't really think so. If it's important, I just get it done. It's not really an issue for me.
Do you often feel so restless that you have to leave your seat even when you’re expected to stay seated?

Um... didn't we just cover that? Like I said earlier, I'll find a reason to get up if a meeting drags on or something. But I don't know if I'd say I feel overwhelmingly restless... I just prefer to move around. I don't really have anything else to add to that.
Do you often do things impulsively without thinking first?
Um... no. I don't really think so. I usually know what I'm doing before I do it. I wouldn't really call myself impulsive.
Do your restlessness or fidgeting ever cause problems for you in daily life?

Um... I guess maybe a little. It's not a huge issue or anything. Just... at work, I've had to correct a few purchase orders, so my planning coordinator does some extra review on my stuff now. 

And, um... at home, I suppose family dinners can get a little tense sometimes. They... they feel like I talk over them. But I wouldn't call it a major problem.
Do you often have trouble sitting quietly when expected to?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, if I need to be quiet, I can be. I don't really have an issue with that.
Do you often make careless mistakes because you miss details when you’re working on things?

Um... I guess sometimes. Like I mentioned before, my planning coordinator has to check my work now. Over the last couple of years, I'll... I'll think I've looked over a vendor spreadsheet really carefully. But then she'll find that I mixed up a SKU, or... or I missed a freight surcharge. Sometimes I'll put the wrong quantity on the purchase order. So... yeah, I suppose it happens.
Do you often feel driven by a motor, like you have to keep moving or can’t slow down?

Um... I don't know about a motor. I just... I guess I like to stay busy. Even on the weekends, I tend to finish one thing and then immediately start another. Just... doing laundry, or checking emails, maybe reorganizing some product samples for work... or touching up a painting. My husband says I never really power down. But... I just have things to get done, that's all.
